search.query: | mstats avg("ups.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | 1=1 | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("ups.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*charge*" | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("ups.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*on_battery*","*device_count*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
